rust_summary: explicit terrain-sheet native model materials, shading and UV shifts.
doc_summary: `native_draw_terrain_model(draw,model,NativeModelRenderOptions)` draws a standalone model with animated block sprite arrays. Material `Model` respects solid/cutout/cutout_mipped quads, or explicitly select `Solid`, `Cutout` or `CutoutMipped`. Cutout uses alpha .1 without mipmaps; mipmapped cutout uses .5. All cull backs and use ordinary opaque color/depth writes. `NativeModelShade::{Model,Off,Entity}` controls directional shading independently of light, including fullbright. `NativeModelUvShift` names original/target sprites and unit-sprite scale/offset; invalid/missing mappings fail before geometry. `uv_shrink_ratio` defaults zero and explicitly supports older FaceBakery UV policy without guessing atlas dimensions. `tint` defaults white and multiplies only tinted quads. Ordinary native model/fluid/Canvas/OIT behavior is unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:terrain_model@.
